title: The Open Question Ledger
proposition: Power should not only have a public record. It should have a public list of the questions that record has not yet answered.
operatingRule: Every question retains what is known, what is not proven, which records are needed, whether a response has been received, and what evidence would change the conclusion.

questions.subject: Abdul Halim Khan
questions.question: Can the record for Abdul Halim Khan be completed with verdict counts, sentencing order and any institution-specific safeguarding findings?

whatIsNotProven: The conviction establishes Khan's crimes and abuse of authority; it does not implicate the mosque, faith community or other religious leaders without separate evidence.
recordsNeeded: Maintain verdict counts, sentencing order and any institution-specific safeguarding findings.
